scenario_prompt: Analyze these Windows event logs for signs of anti-forensic activity or log tampering. Identify what actions were taken to cover tracks and which logs were affected. Use only evidence present in the data.

expected_findings.indicator: Event ID 1102: Security audit log was cleared
expected_findings.explanation: The Windows Security log was cleared, a classic anti-forensic technique to remove evidence of malicious activity.

expected_findings.indicator: Event ID 104: System log was cleared
expected_findings.explanation: The System event log was also cleared, indicating a broad attempt to erase forensic evidence across multiple log channels.

notes: Easy case: only 91 events, all signal. Two clear event IDs (104, 1102) directly indicate log clearing, a well-known Defense Evasion technique (T1070.001).
